扩大条件句法分割的适用性，以进行条件信念基础的推理Broadening the Applicability of Conditional Syntax Splitting for Reasoning from Conditional Belief Bases

Lars-Phillip Spiegel lars-phillip.spiegel@fernuni-hagen.de    Jonas Haldimann jonas@haldimann.de    Jesse Heyninck jesse.heyninck@ou.nl    Gabriele Kern-Isberner gabriele.kern-isberner@cs.tu-dortmund.de    Christoph Beierle christoph.beierle@fernuni-hagen.de [ [ [ [ [
摘要Abstract

在来自条件置信库的非单调推理中，满足语法分裂假设的推理算子允许仅考虑置信库的相关部分，前提是置信库基于不相交的签名分裂成子库。 由于这种不相交在实践中很少见，因此安全条件语法分割被提出作为语法分割的推广，允许子库中的条件共享一些原子。 最近，这种条件句的重叠已被证明仅限于琐碎的、自我实现的条件句。 在本文中，我们提出了安全条件语法分割的概括，该方法拓宽了 分裂假设的适用性。 与安全条件语法分割相比，我们的广义概念 支持信念基础的语法分裂In nonmonotonic reasoning from conditional belief bases, an inference operator satisfying syntax splitting postulates allows for taking only the relevant parts of a belief base into account, provided that the belief base splits into subbases based on disjoint signatures. Because such disjointness is rare in practice, safe conditional syntax splitting has been proposed as a generalization of syntax splitting, allowing the conditionals in the subbases to share some atoms. Recently this overlap of conditionals has been shown to be limited to trivial, self-fulfilling conditionals. In this article, we propose a generalization of safe conditional syntax splittings that broadens the applicability of splitting postulates. In contrast to safe conditional syntax splitting, our generalized notion supports syntax splittings of a belief baseΔ\Delta的底基地在哪里where the subbases ofΔ\Delta可以共享原子和重要的条件。我们说明了这个新概念如何克服以前分裂概念的局限性，并且我们识别真正的分裂，将它们与简单的分裂区分开来，这些简单的分裂不能为归纳推理提供好处。may share atoms and nontrivial conditionals. We illustrate how this new notion overcomes limitations of previous splitting concepts, and we identify genuine splittings, separating them from simple splittings that do not provide benefits for inductive inference fromΔ\Delta。我们根据我们的概括引入调整后的推理假设 条件语法分割，并且我们根据这些假设评估了几种流行的归纳推理运算符。此外，我们还展示了 尽管每个满足广义条件语法分裂的归纳推理运算符也满足条件语法分裂，但反之则不成立。. We introduce adjusted inference postulates based on our generalization of conditional syntax splitting, and we evaluate several popular inductive inference operators with respect to these postulates. Furthermore, we show that, while every inductive inference operator satisfying generalized conditional syntax splitting also satisfies conditional syntax splitting, the reverse does not hold.

1 简介Introduction

人类推理方法和形式推理方法通常都依赖于限制给定推理任务所考虑的信息量，从而排除不相关的事实和知识。语法分割的概念Both human and formal reasoning methods often rely on restricting the amount of information taken into account for a given reasoning task, tuning out unrelated facts and knowledge. The concept of syntax splitting(Parikh99; PeppasWilliamsChopraFoo2015; Kern-IsbernerBrewka17), 以及最小无关性的相关概念, and of the related idea of minimum irrelevance(Weydert98KR)已被引入作为正式化这一目标的步骤。这个想法已经从条件信念基础转移到归纳推理，座右铭是“语法分裂= 归纳推理算子的公设 (Rel) 和 (Ind) 形式的“相关性 + 独立性”have been introduced as steps to formalize this goal. This idea has been transferred to inductive inference from conditional belief bases under the motto “syntax splitting = relevance + independence” in the form of postulates (Rel) and (Ind) for inductive inference operators(KernIsbernerBeierleBrewka2020KR)，接受信仰基础上的分裂, taking splittings over a belief baseΔ\Delta考虑到底基地的位置into account where the subbasesΔ1,Δ2\Delta_{1},\Delta_{2}是通过不相交的子签名给出的are given over disjoint subsignatures ofΔ\Delta.

在实践中，这样的 分裂很少见，因为子签名的不相交施加了严格的限制。 概念 条件语法分割In practice, such splittings are rare because the disjointness of subsignatures imposes a harsh restriction. The concept of conditional syntax splitting(HeyninckKernIsbernerMeyerHaldimannBeierle2023AAAI)是一种克服此限制的方法，允许is an approach to overcome this restriction by allowingΔ1\Delta_{1}和andΔ2\Delta_{2}在各自的子签名中共享原子。 为确保 给定联合原子的语义（条件）独立性，已经制定了安全条件， 在基地内启用本地推理。 条件相关性假设 (CRel) 实现了局部推理的思想，将仅关注信念基础的句法相关部分的能力形式化，而条件独立性假设 (CInd) 描述了忽略句法不相关信息的能力to share atoms in their respective subsignatures. To ensure semantic (conditional) independence given the joint atoms, a safety condition has been formulated, enabling local reasoning within the subbases. The postulate of conditional relevance (CRel) implements this idea of localized reasoning, formalizing the ability to focus only on syntactically relevant parts of a belief base, while the postulate of conditional independence (CInd) describes the ability to leave aside syntactically irrelevant information(HeyninckKernIsbernerMeyerHaldimannBeierle2023AAAI)。 此外，条件独立性假设 （CInd）用于安全条件分裂的特点是避免 溺水效应. Furthermore, the postulate of conditional independence (CInd) for safe conditional splittings characterizes avoiding the drowning effect(Pearl1990systemZTARK; BenferhatDuboisPrade93), 给出了臭名昭著的溺水问题的第一个正式定义 前面仅通过具体例子进行了描述, yielding the first formal definition of the notorious drowning problem that had been described before only by specific examples(HeyninckKernIsbernerMeyerHaldimannBeierle2023AAAI)。 这些拆分不仅通过形式化条件相关性和独立性的概念从理论角度来看很有趣，而且还通过允许将条件推理分解为与给定查询相关的子库来对应用程序产生影响，通常会显着减少相关签名。因此，扩大这种分裂的适用性不仅提供了理论见解，而且还为应用带来了好处。. These splittings are not only interesting from a theoretical point of view by formalizing notions of conditional relevance and independence, but also have consequences for applications by allowing the breaking down of conditional reasoning to the subbases relevant for a given query, usually reducing the relevant signature significantly. Hence, broadening the applicability of such splittings provides not only theoretical insights, but also benefits for applications.

近期的情况显示，安全状况It has been shown recently that the safety condition in(HeyninckKernIsbernerMeyerHaldimannBeierle2023AAAI)会产生不良后果，即交叉点中的每个条件 的has the undesirable consequence that every conditional in the intersection ofΔ1\Delta_{1}和andΔ2\Delta_{2}是一个简单的自我实现条件，意味着它不能被证伪is a trivial self-fulfilling conditional, meaning that it cannot be falsified(BeierleSpiegelHaldimannWilhelmHeyninckKernIsberner2024KR), 因此 对推理可能的分割利益施加严格限制。 我们对这种安全条件进行了概括， 允许交集, thus imposing a strong restriction on possible splitting benefits for inference. We develop a generalization of this safety condition, allowing the intersection ofΔ1\Delta_{1}和andΔ2\Delta_{2}包含更有意义的条件。 通过增加分裂的数量和可以利用分裂进行归纳推理的信念基础的数量，这极大地拓宽了语法分裂的应用可能性。 本文的主要贡献是：to contain more meaningful conditionals. This greatly broadens the application possibilities of syntax splitting by increasing both the amount of splittings and the amount of belief bases where splittings can be exploited for inductive reasoning. p-蕴涵p-Entailment|∼p\mbox{$\,\mathrel{|}\mkern-0.5mu\joinrel\sim\,$}^{\!p}

(Adams1975; GoldszmidtPearl96)考虑信念基础的所有模型并且 是最谨慎的优先归纳推理算子。 可以用系统 P 来表征 因为它 精确地许可通过迭代应用系统 P 的规则可以获得的推论considers all models of a belief base and is the most cautious preferential inductive inference operator. 系统ZSystem Z|∼z\mbox{$\,\mathrel{|}\mkern-0.5mu\joinrel\sim\,$}^{\!z}

(GoldszmidtPearl96)确定唯一定义的最小排名模型determines the uniquely defined minimal ranking model ofΔ\Delta, 和它 与理性闭合相吻合, and it coincides with rational closure(LehmannMagidor92)。 System Z 是基于 OCF 的归纳推理算子的示例。. System Z is an example of an OCF-based inductive inference operator.

系统WSystem W|∼𝗐\mbox{$\,\mathrel{|}\mkern-0.5mu\joinrel\sim\,$}^{\!\sf{w}}

(KomoBeierle2020KI; KomoBeierle2022AMAI)基于世界上的首选结构，并且它 捕获 C 推理和 Z 系统 从而合理地关闭。is based on a preferred structure on worlds, and it captures both c-inference and system Z and thus rational closure.

p-蕴涵由其他四个归纳推理算子扩展，因为所有五个归纳推理算子都是优先的，而 字典推理扩展了所有其他四个归纳推理运算符；有关它们之间相互关系的概述，请参见p-Entailment is extended by the four other inductive inference operators in the sense that all five inductive inference operators are preferential, while lexicographic inference extends all other four inductive inference operators; for an overview of the interrelationships among them see(HaldimannBeierle2024IJAR)。在本文的其余部分中，我们将评估这些以及进一步的归纳推理运算符的语法分裂行为。. 考虑信念基础Consider the belief baseΔs​u​n={(s¯|r),(r¯|s),(b|s​r),(g|b),(o|s​r¯),(o¯|r),(u|o​r)}\Delta^{sun}=\{(\overline{s}|r),\allowbreak(\overline{r}|s),\allowbreak(b|sr),\allowbreak(g|b),\allowbreak(o|s\overline{r}),\allowbreak(\overline{o}|r),\allowbreak(u|or)\}描述如下：如果天气晴朗，那么通常就不是晴朗，反之亦然。如果同时下雨和晴天，那么我们通常可以观察到下雨。也许出于迷信，我们相信在彩虹的尽头通常可以找到一些（g）古老的东西。与此无关，如果天气晴朗且不下雨，我们通常会在户外度过一段时间。如果下雨，我们通常不会在外面度过。尽管我们有正常的习惯，但如果我们确实在外面度过了时光并且下雨了，那么我们通常会带一把雨伞。describing the following: If it is (r)ainy, then usually it is not (s)unny and vice versa. If it is rainy and sunny at the same time, then we can usually observe a rain(b)ow. Maybe superstitiously, we believe that there is usually some (g)old to be found at the end of the rainbow. Unrelated to this, we usually spend some time (o)utside if it is sunny and not rainy. If it is rainy, then we usually do not spend time outside. 我们现在将引入假设来评估关于广义安全条件语法分割的归纳推理运算符。这些假设的想法是，对于具有（广义安全条件）语法分裂的信念基础，对一个子签名的推断应该独立于有关另一个子签名的信息（假设共享子签名的估值是固定的）。 这些假设类似于条件相关性和条件独立性假设We will now introduce postulates to evaluate inductive inference operators with respect to generalized safe conditional syntax splitting. The idea of these postulates is that for a belief base with (generalized safe conditional) syntax splitting, inference over one subsignature should be independent from the information about the other subsignature (given that the valuation of the shared subsignature is fixed). 5 基于 c 表示评估归纳推理算子Evaluating Inductive Inference Operators based on c-Representations

本节介绍几个使用 c 表示的归纳推理运算符This section addresses several inductive inference operators employing c-representations(KernIsberner2001; KernIsberner2004AMAI)。在教派。. In Sect.5.1，我们提出关于 c 表示的命题和引理，并提出条件的概念, we present propositions and lemmata regarding c-representations and present the notion of conditionalκ\kappa- 独立性将对以下部分有所帮助。在教派。-independence that will be helpful for the following sections. In Sect.5.2，我们证明了关于由适当策略选择的单个 c 表示的推理, we show that inference with respect to single c-representations selected by an appropriate strategy(BeierleKernIsberner2021FLAIRS)满足广义条件语法分割。在教派。satisfies generalized conditional syntax splitting. In Sect.5.3，我们证明 c-核心闭包推理, we show that c-core closure inference(WilhelmKernIsbernerBeierle2024FoIKScb)完全符合广义条件语法分割。在教派。fully complies with generalized conditional syntax splitting. In Sect.5.4，我们还证明了关于所有 c 表示的推论, we show that also inference with respect to all c-representations(BeierleEichhornKernIsbernerKutsch2018AMAI)满足广义条件语法分割。satisfies generalized conditional syntax splitting.

c-表示的一个基本属性是对于任何语法分割A fundamental property of c-representations is that for any syntax splittingΔ=Δ1​⋃Σ1,Σ2Δ2\Delta=\Delta_{1}\bigcup\limits_{\Sigma_{1},\Sigma_{2}}\Delta_{2}的组成the composition of任何any底基的影响向量产生一个影响向量impact vectors for the subbases yields an impact vector forΔ\Delta, 反之亦然, and vice versa(KernIsbernerBeierleBrewka2020KR)。 该属性还被证明可以扩展到安全的条件语法分割. This property was also shown to extend to safe conditional syntax splittings(BeierleSpiegelHaldimannWilhelmHeyninckKernIsberner2024KR)。然而，展示这一点的关键部分是. However, a key part in showing this wasLemma˜5这不再适用于广义安全条件语法分割。事实上，组合属性不再成立，因为分配给条件句的影响which no longer holds for generalized safe conditional syntax splittings. Indeed the composition property no longer holds, as the impacts assigned to the conditionals inΔ3\Delta_{3}两个底基之间可能存在很大差异。因此，我们在这里展示了稍弱的属性。虽然它仍然指出任何影响向量can be vastly different between the two subbases. Thus, we show a slightly weaker property here. While it still states that any impact vector forΔ\Delta可以分为子库的影响向量，子库的影响向量可能只产生一个影响向量can be split into impact vectors for the subbases, impact vectors for the subbases may only yield an impact vector forΔ\Delta如果它们与分配给条件句的影响相匹配if they match on the impacts assigned to the conditionals inΔ3\Delta_{3}.

5.2 使用单个 c 表示进行推理Inference with Single c-Representations

在本节中，我们将研究针对单个 c 表示的推理，该推理是通过将一个 c 表示分配给每个置信库而获得的，从而产生基于 OCF 的归纳推理算子。 为此，引入 (CIndIn this section we look at inference with respect to a single c-representation, obtained by assigning one c-representation to each belief base, yielding an OCF-based inductive inference operator. 7 结论和未来的工作Conclusions and Future Work

在这篇文章中我们 概括了条件语法分割的安全概念，允许子库共享重要的条件。 这是通过引入更宽松的安全概念来实现的， 显着拓宽了有益分裂技术的应用范围。 此外，我们 将真正的分裂确定为有意义的条件语法分裂的子类，将它们与简单分裂类分开，简单分裂不为归纳推理提供任何优势。In this article we generalized the notion of safety for conditional syntax splittings, allowing the subbases to share non-trivial conditionals. This is achieved by introducing a more relaxed notion of safety, significantly broadening the application scope of the beneficial splitting techniques. Moreover, we identified genuine splittings as the subclass of meaningful conditional syntax splittings, separating them from the class of simple splittings which provide no advantage for inductive inference.

因此，我们在利用条件语法分割假设进行归纳推理应用方面迈出了两个主要步骤。首先，我们通过使条件语法分割假设适应更宽松的安全概念，显着扩大了条件语法分割假设的适用性，使它们能够应用于更多的分割。这包括使它们适用于以前的假设根本无法有意义地应用的信念基础（参见示例）Thus, we have made two major steps towards utilizing conditional syntax splitting postulates for inductive inference applications. First, we have significantly broadened the applicability of conditional syntax splitting postulates by adapting them to a more relaxed notion of safety, allowing them to be applied to significantly more splittings. This includes making them applicable to belief bases where previous postulates were not able to be meaningfully applied at all (cf. Example7）。其次，我们将有利于归纳推理的分裂归类为真正的分裂，过滤掉该过程中大量的简单分裂（参见示例）). Second, we have classified splittings beneficial for inductive inference as genuine splittings, filtering out the large class of simple splittings in the process (cf. Example10）。因此，我们能够识别那些可以有意义地应用条件语法分割假设的分割，作为真正的、广义的安全分割。). Thus we were able to identify those splittings where conditional syntax splitting postulates can be meaningfully applied as exactly the genuine, generalized safe splittings.

我们引入了适应的条件语法分割假设，以适应我们的条件语法分割的广义概念。 新假设 (CSynSplitWe introduced adapted conditional syntax splitting postulates to fit with our generalized notion of conditional syntax splitting. The new postulate (CSynSplitg）覆盖的分裂比 (CSynSplit)，因此更相关，但更难满足，即存在符合条件语法拆分但不符合广义条件语法拆分的归纳推理运算符。 我们证明了词典推理、System W、基于适当选择策略的单个 c 表示的归纳推理、c 核心闭包和 c 推理都完全符合广义条件语法分割。虽然 System Z 无法满足广义条件语法拆分，但我们证明它符合广义条件相关性。) covers more splittings than (CSynSplit) and is thus more relevant, but harder to satisfy, i.e., there exist inductive inference operators complying with conditional syntax splitting but not with generalized conditional syntax splitting. We showed that lexicographic inference, System W, inductive inference with a single c-representation based on an adequate selection strategy, c-core closure, and c-inference all fully comply with generalized conditional syntax splitting. While System Z fails to satisfy generalized conditional syntax splitting, we showed that it complies with generalized conditional relevance.

在未来的工作中，我们将研究我们的句法上下文过滤方法的确切关系In future work we will study the exact relationship of our approach to syntactic contextual filtering(dupin2024form)以及命题遗忘and to propositional forgetting(LangLiberatoreMarquis2003local; SauerwaldKernIsbernerBeckerBeierle2022SUM; SauerwaldBeierleKernIsberner2024FoIKS)。我们将利用分裂技术的有益特性来实现归纳推理. We will exploit the beneficial properties of splitting techniques for implementations of inductive inference(BeierleHaldimannSaninSchwarzerSpangSpiegelvonBerg2024SUM; BeierleHaldimannSaninSpangSpiegelvonBerg2025JELIA), 我们会适应 这里显示的概念还包括满足较弱的一致性概念的信念基础（参见, and we will adapt the concepts shown here to include also belief bases that satisfy a weaker notion of consistency (cf.(HaldimannBeierleKernIsbernerMeyer2023FLAIRSproceedings; HaldimannBeierleKernIsberner2024FoIKS)).
